issues.description: Template code constructs a Stim Circuit using an integer argument (stim.Circuit(n_shots)) inside simulate_msd_one_round, whereas the solution and typical usage construct a Circuit with no arguments (stim.Circuit()). This constructor parameter mismatch in the template is likely unintentional and will cause runtime errors or confusion for students attempting to run or implement the simulation, preventing them from following the intended exercise flow.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to construct the Stim circuit with no arguments (circ = stim.Circuit()) to match the solution and standard Stim usage. If an explicit qubit count is required, document and use the correct Stim API call; otherwise remove the integer argument.
